Name: CIVIL_CIVILCELLS_DGNLIB_FILE
LongDescription: 1. This variable defines both the directory and specific file name of the Civil Cells DGN Library. Example: CIVIL_CIVILCELLS_DGNLIB_FILE = c:\workspace\dgnlibs\civilcells.dgnlib 2. This variable should allow the use of wildcards. Example: CIVIL_CIVILCELLS_DGNLIB_FILE = c:\workspace\dgnlibs\*.dgnlib 3. If this variable is NOT set or the dgnlib file is not found then the process should just work as it does today (i.e. just look inside each dgnlib and list any that contain civil cells). 4. If this variable IS set and the file is found then this file should be used to list the civil cells and for nothing further. In other words if this file contains other civil items (such as feature definitions or project settings or filters) they should be ignored.

Name: CIVIL_CIVILSETTINGS_READONLY
LongDescription: If set to a value of 1, all standards, preferences or features that come from a DGN Library are persisted as read-only in the active file.

Name: CIVIL_CIVILTMDGNLIBLIST
LongDescription: See CIVIL_CIVILCELLDGNLIBLIST for more details."

Name: CIVIL_CONTENTMANAGEMENTDGNLIBLIST
LongDescription: "This variable defines both the directory and specific file name of the feature definitions DGN Library.

Name: CIVIL_DEFAULT_CURVE_STROKING
LongDescription: Defines how often to compute a point or template drop interval location along a curve segment with extra points being computed based on the chord offset from the horizontal curve. The value defines the chord height used to calculate the extra points. If not set, the value defaults to 0.01. This is used in Corridor Modeling when Horizontal Curve Densification is applied.

Name: CIVIL_DEFAULT_LINEAR_STROKING
LongDescription: Defines how often to compute a point or template drop interval location on a tangent segment.This variable is not used by Corridor Modeling. If not set, the value defaults to 10. This is used when generating 3d elements and the apply Template command.

Name: CIVIL_DEFAULT_PROFILE_STROKING
LongDescription: Defines how often to compute a point or template drop interval location along a profile, with extra points being computed based on a chord offset from the profile. The value defines the chord height used to calculate the extra points. If not set, the value defaults to 0.1. This is used in Corridor Modeling when Vertical Curve Densification is applied.

Name: CIVIL_DEFAULT_STATION_LOCK
LongDescription: If set to 'true' then stations for various commands are calculated and kept at even numbers. For example, template drops would always fall on even stations in the event of an equation that could cause it to do otherwise. If not set or set to 'false', then the station values will be maintained at the specified increments.

Name: CIVIL_DEFAULTSETTINGS
LongDescription: Used to locate the Folder holding the XML file that include the Civil Accudraw defaults.

Name: CIVIL_DESIGNSTANDARDSDGNLIBLIST
LongDescription: See CIVIL_CIVILCELLDGNLIBLIST for more details."

Name: CIVIL_DISALLOW_LOCKCHANGES
LongDescription: If set to a value of 1, it disallows any lock changes to existing rules. In other words, it prevents a locked rule from being unlocked or an unlocked rule from being locked.

Name: CIVIL_DISALLOW_REFERENCEDELETIONS
LongDescription: If set to a value of 1, it does not allow an element to be deleted if that element is referenced by another. Does not work across reference files.

Name: CIVIL_PRODUCT_ACTIVE
LongDescription: MicroStation Configuration Variable that specifies which Civil software (InRoads or GEOPAK) will interact with the Civil Geometry tools. Installation of InRoads automatically sets this variable equal to InRoads. To have GEOPAK interact with the Civil Geometry tools, overwrite the InRoads value with a new value of GEOPAK. Exit and restart MicroStation for this setting to take effect.

Name: CIVIL_PROJECTSETTINGSDGNLIBLIST
LongDescription: "This variable defines both the directory and specific file name of the design standards DGN Library.

Name: CIVIL_REPORTS_DIRECTORY
LongDescription: If the variable is set to a valid directory location, then the software would look at this specific location to locate the XML reports. If this variable is NOT set or it's set to an invalid location, then the software would look at the location where Civil installs the reports by default. NOTE: If the InRoads Project Default XSL location is defined then that is used before CIVIL_REPORTS_DIRECTORY. This maintains continuity for InRoads users.

Name: CIVIL_ROADWAY_TEMPLATE_LIBRARY
LongDescription: Defines the default template library (ITL).

Name: CIVIL_SHOW_MS_PROPERTIES
LongDescription: Display extra MS properties that are normally hidden on Civil Elements

Name: CIVIL_STOP_COMMAND_DEFAULTS
LongDescription: This stops the Civil commands storing their defaults as xml. Mainly used for Automated testing. Existing files will have to be deleted as it does not stop the system reading them.

Name: CIVIL_SUPERELEVATION_RULES_DIRECTORY
LongDescription: Defines the directory to be used as the default location for superelevation preference (SEP/SR) files.

Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_APPEND_ATTRIBUTES_TO_DESCRIPTIONS
LongDescription: If this variable is set to 1, then any attributes associated with a point during the import process will be written to the point’s DESCRIPTION field as well as the attribute field. By populating the DESCRIPTION field, the data can be annotated graphically as the DESCRIPTION. The ATTRIBUTE field cannot be annotated.

Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_DISABLE_DIVIDE_BY_TWELVE
LongDescription: If set to a value of 1, this variable indicates that the sizes read from a GEOPAK SMD XML file should not be divided by 12 when linked into Survey Feature Definitions. (Applicable for GEOPAK XML SMD files in an English environment only)

Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_ELEVATION_POSITION_FIVE_ANGLE
LongDescription: If set to a value of 1, allow the elevation annotation to be rotated by the angle specified when the label position is set to position 5. (GEOPAK XML SMD only)

Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_GEOID_BINFILE_FOLDER
LongDescription: Defines an alternate directory where the GEOID BIN files may be located. If not set, the standard GEOID BIN location is used.

Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_STYLEFILE_FILE
LongDescription: Defines the Style file that is linked in the Survey Feature definitions. Available options are an XIN from InRoads, an XML from a GEOPAK SMD or a PSS from MX.

Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_SURVEYOPTIONS_NAME
LongDescription: As the XIN can contain multiple instances of Survey Options, this allows the definition of a particular Survey Options to apply when reading the XIN file. If this variable is not defined, then the LAST occurence of the Survey Options is used. (InRoads only)

Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_USERTIW_FOLDER
LongDescription: Defines an alternate directory where user .TIW files can be located.

Name: CIVIL_TM_USERTIW_FOLDER
LongDescription: Variable sets the path for the Wizard Setting File for the command Create Terrain Model from ASCII File.

Name: CIVIL_XIN_FILE
LongDescription: Defines the default XIN file. (InRoads only)

Name: DA_DISABLE_DIVIDE_BY_TWELVE.
LongDescription: Ability to disable dividing by twelve when using Annotation Scale. This will accommodate ratios for annotation scales. (e.g. 1:100)

Name: DTM_BSPLINE_SMOOTHING_FACTOR
LongDescription: When contour smoothing option is set to Bspline this factor controls the degree of smoothing. The value ranges from 0.0 to 5.0. If it is outside of these limits then it is set to either the bottom range or top range. Therefore when set to 6 then the program will use 5. If set to -1 then the program will use 0. A smoothing factor of zero will force the spline to honor all contour vertices. An increase to the smoothing factor moves away from contour vertices. If a contour vertex is a tin point or on a break line, the smoothing factor for that vertex is set to 0.0.

Name: GPK_ACBOOK_DDBFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the default DDB file as well as the default directory for DDB files. When initially invoking the Design & Computation Manager, this DDB file appears in the Path dialog. Moreover, when selecting File > Open, the directory tree is set where this DDB file resides, even if another DDB file from another directory is the current DDB. Not setting this configuration variable would cause Design & Computation Manager to initially look for ..\GEOPAK\bin\default.ddb. Subsequent searches would start in the same directory as the current DDB file.

Name: GPK_ACBOOK_DDBFILE_STYLES
LongDescription: This variable sets the DDB file that defines the styles available in Corridor Modeling. Corridor Modeling imports the drafting standards from the selected DDB file into a .xin file. If this variable is not set, the software uses a default DDB file.

Name: GPK_ACBOOK_ITEM_HELP_INDEX_FILE
LongDescription: Points to the location of a csv formatted index page. Example: z:\GEOPAK\Standards\Help\Index.csv

Name: GPK_ACBOOK_ITEM_HELP_METHOD
LongDescription: This variable can be set to either INDEX_FILE or URL_TEMPLATE.

Name: GPK_ACBOOK_ITEM_HELP_URL_TEMPLATE
LongDescription: Points to the location of a URL. Example: http://www.agency.com/adhoc-help/12345.html

Name: GPK_ACBOOK_POBPOELABEL
LongDescription: Provides the option of additional information being included in conjunction with the Point on Tangent (POT) labels - displayed at the beginning and end of alignments. The following information is included with the Point on Tangent (POT): Point of Beginning (POB) Point of End (POE) The option is activated once the variable is set, using only the value = 1, then the software will produce labels containing the additional options listed above.

Name: GPK_ACBOOK_XINFILE_STYLES
LongDescription: This variable points to a global .xin file on a server. When this variable is set and the .xin file it points to exists, the Import DDB option is disabled.

Name: GPK_ACCUSNAP_IDENTIFY_ELEMENTS_AUTOMATICALLY
LongDescription: Set to a value of 0, MicroStation element attribute is displayed and the GEOPAK attribute is NOT displayed. If set to 1, both the MicroStation and GEOPAK attributes are displayed.

Name: GPK_AUTOPWJOBDIR
LongDescription: Used to help control the location of the GPK file when working in a ProjectWise environment. When the configuration variable is set, the COGO Job Directory will automatically be set to the value of the configuration variable PLUS the current ProjectWise folder.

Name: GPK_BOREHOLE_GTPFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of the default GEOPAK GeoTechnical Preferences file. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses default.gtp located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_COGO_EXPORT_PREFERENCE_FILE
LongDescription: Denotes the name and path of the default file used in COGO Navigator for exporting geometric data to a text file.

Name: GPK_COMPUTATION_ENGLISH_UNIT_DEF_FILE
LongDescription: Files containing the English or Metric units used for computation in D&C Manager.

Name: GPK_COMPUTATION_GRAPHIC_TABULATION_PREFERENCE_FILE
LongDescription: Denotes the default .qtd settings file that is utilized to configure the type of table and content for the quantity computation results, when selecting the export format option "Table" from the Computation Result dialog.

Name: GPK_COMPUTATION_USE_MINIMUM_MAXIMUM_OFFSETS
LongDescription: When computing with D&C Manager for a linear element or a shape, GEOPAK computes the min and max station point. This information is then exported to QM. In QM it shows Minimum Station, Minimum Offset, Maximum Station, and Maximum Offset. Minimum and maximum offsets means "offset of the minimum station point" and "offset of the maximum station point". If this variable is set and its value = 1, then the software exports the true minimum and maximum offsets.

Name: GPK_COMPUTATON_CSV_REPORT_PREFERENCE_FILE
LongDescription: Denotes the default .qtd settings file that is utilized to format the structure and content of the Comma Separate File (.csv) which will contain the quantity computation result, when selecting the export format option "CSV By Item" from the Computation Results dialog.

Name: GPK_CRITSYNT_BASICDRWFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and names of the default criteria syntax files. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses the default files located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_CRITSYNT_DRAWTEXTFILE

Name: GPK_CRITSYNT_SUBSTRNGFILE

LongDescription: For getting the miscellaneous Utilities in Drainage/Water/Sewer Profiles to draw the utilities in the symbology of the plan view element – so the symbologies are different. GPK_CROSSING_SYMBOLOGY = 1

Name: GPK_DC_3PCDIR
LongDescription: Denotes the directory where 3PC criteria files can be found by D&C Manager. Not setting this configuration variable would result in the D&C Manager looking for criteria files in the working directory.

Name: GPK_DDB_NO_DIVIDE_BY_TWELVE
LongDescription: Defines how the annotation scale is applied, whether it should be divided by 12 or not when applying annotation to a Civil Geometry chains.

Name: GPK_DDB_STA_CONTROL_PNTS
LongDescription: This variable is needed to set control point labels for Civil Geometry elements. These settings are not stored in the DDB file but are set in the dialog at run-time. 0 = As Per Preferences 1 = Force Left 2 = Force Right

Name: GPK_DDB_STA_LARGE_TICKS
LongDescription: This variable is needed to control large station tics and labels for Civil Geometry elements. These settings are not stored in the DDB file but are set in the dialog at run-time. 0 = Ticks Left Label Left 1 = Ticks Right Labels Right 2 = Ticks Both Labels Left 3 = Ticks Both Labels Right

Name: GPK_DDB_STA_SMALL_TICKS
LongDescription: This variable is needed to control small station tics and labels for Civil Geometry elements. These settings are not stored in the DDB file but are set in the dialog at run-time. 0 = Ticks Left Label Left 1 = Ticks Right Labels Right 2 = Ticks Both Labels Left 3 = Ticks Both Labels Right

Name: GPK_DISABLE_PW_SHEET_CHECKIN
LongDescription: This variable is used to turn off the automatic ProjectWise check-in of sheets when created by GEOPAK. If the variable is not set, then by default the sheets are checked in. 0 = automatic check-in is enabled. (default) 1 = automatic check-in is disabled.

Name: GPK_DISABLE_PW_TITLEBLOCKS
LongDescription: This variable is used to turn off searching for title blocks by ProjectWise when creating Sheets in GEOPAK. Variables for setting the precision of the area value generated by the space tool. 0 = Title block search is enabled. (default) 1 = Title block search is disabled.

Name: GPK_DRGPREF_DEFCELLLIB
LongDescription: Path for the cell library utilized within the Drainage Preferences. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses gdcel.cel located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_DRGPREF_DEFDRLIB
LongDescription: Path for the drainage library. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses default.dlb located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_DRGPREF_DEFPREFDIR
LongDescription: Path for the drainage preferences. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses the default located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_DRGPREF_FILENAME
LongDescription: Will use the specified path and file name to set the default drainage preference file.

Name: GPK_DRGPREF_LINK_MATERIAL_OTHER
LongDescription:
Changes the Material pulldown in the Drainage Library from ‘Steel’ to ‘Other’.
GPK_DRGPREF_LINK_MATERIAL_OTHER = 1

Name: GPK_DTM_LOADDEF
LongDescription: Loads the specified file when the Load DTM Features tool is opened.

Name: GPK_DTM_MNDOT_VOID_VALIDATE
LongDescription: If activated (set to 1), it validates and cleans ADJOINING voids and then assembles adjoining voids into one void.

Name: GPK_DTM_VALIDATE_POLYGONAL_FEATURES
LongDescription: If activated (set to 1), it validates and cleans INTERSECTING Voids and Islands and assembles intersecting voids and/or islands into one void and/or island. If this is set it takes precedent.

Name: GPK_EDITOR
LongDescription: If GPK_EDITOR is defined, that program will be used, such as Notepad, Wordpad, Ultraedit, etc. If GPK_EDITOR is undefined, the MDL based editor is utilized. Include the entire path and executable file name.

Name: GPK_ENGMET_TXTFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of the default conversion file. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses the default located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_FORCE_ALLCFGVARS
LongDescription: Apply the force behavior to all GEOPAK configuration variables.

Name: GPK_FORCE_SURVMNGR_SMDFILE
LongDescription: Using force variables causes GEOPAK to use the resolution of the variable exclusively and ignore the GEOPAK resource files. These variables have the keyword _FORCE_ inserted into the generic variables. If this is defined then the variable is always used to define the file and or directory used. Without this forcing, the resource file has priority. Note: Not all GEOPAK variables have a force variable. See the GEOPAK Help for a list of those variables that can be forced. The syntax to set and then force the variable is illustrated left. Note the variable is set first, and then the force option is a second line. GPK_FORCE_SURVMNGR_SMDFILE = 1

Name: GPK_GEOTECH_FILETYPE
LongDescription: If one is set, the "gtd" format is utilized. Otherwise, a default type of "mdb" is assumed.

Name: GPK_GWSPREF_FILENAME
LongDescription: This variable allows the user to point to a specific preference file when opening the Water and Sewer Preference Dialog.

Name: GPK_HA_ASYMMETRICAL_TAPERED_CURVE_TABLE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of design table files. When the variables are not utilized, GEOPAK utilizes files located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_HA_ASYMMETRICAL_THREE_CENTERED_CURVE_TABLE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of design table files. When the variables are not utilized, GEOPAK utilizes files located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_HA_SPIRAL_DESIGN_TABLE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of design table files. When the variables are not utilized, GEOPAK utilizes files located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_HA_SYMMETRICAL_TAPERED_CURVE_TABLE

Name: GPK_LABELER_DRGSTYLEFILE

Name: GPK_LABELER_PLANSTYLEFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and names of the default labeler style files. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses the default files located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_LABELER_PROFSTYLEFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and names of the default labeler style files. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses the default files located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_LABELER_WATSEWSTYLEFILE

Name: GPK_LABELER_XSSTYLEFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and names of the default labeler style files. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses the default files located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_LDEDIT_LDBFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of the default legal description library file.

Name: GPK_LEVEL_CREATE_NEW
LongDescription: If set to 1, when a prescribed level is not found, GEOPAK creates the level and places the element on it. If set to zero or not set, then no levels are created. If a function specifies a specific level and it is not found then the graphics are created on the default level.

Name: GPK_LEVEL_DEFAULT
LongDescription: Defines a level name to be used as default for GEOPAK. GEOPAK will draw to this level when the prescribed level is not found. If not defined, the element is drawn to the MicroStation default level.

Name: GPK_LEVEL_PROFILE_CELL
LongDescription: Controls the level name on which the Profile Cell is placed. If not defined, GEOPAK places it on the level assigned to number 63. GPK_LEVEL_PROFILE_CELL = Level Name

Name: GPK_LEVEL_SET_BYLEVELS
LongDescription: If set to 1, selecting a level from a graphical symbology dialog will cause the color, weight and style to automatically default to ByLevel. If not defined, all parameters must be set.

Name: GPK_LEVEL_WARNING
LongDescription: If set to 1, a message is issued whenever GEOPAK draws an element and its prescribed level is not found. The element is drawn elsewhere. If not set, no warning is issued.

Name: GPK_LEVEL_XS_CELL
LongDescription: Controls the level name on which the Cross Section Cells are placed. If not defined, GEOPAK places them on the level assigned to number 63. GPK_LEVEL_XS_CELL = Level Name

Name: GPK_MENU_HIDE_DEACTIVATE
LongDescription: When activated, the product hidden from the displaying on the main Applications pulldown menu, assuming the product is licensed and loaded.

Name: GPK_MENU_HIDE_DRAINAGE
LongDescription: When activated, the product hidden from the displaying on the main Applications pulldown menu, assuming the product is licensed and loaded.

Name: GPK_MENU_HIDE_LANDSCAPE
LongDescription: When activated, the product hidden from the displaying on the main Applications pulldown menu, assuming the product is licensed and loaded.

Name: GPK_MENU_HIDE_ROAD
LongDescription: When activated, the product hidden from the displaying on the main Applications pulldown menu, assuming the product is licensed and loaded.

Name: GPK_MENU_HIDE_SITE
LongDescription: When activated, the product hidden from the displaying on the main Applications pulldown menu, assuming the product is licensed and loaded.

Name: GPK_MENU_HIDE_SURVEY
LongDescription: When activated, the product hidden from the displaying on the main Applications pulldown menu, assuming the product is licensed and loaded.

Name: GPK_MENU_HIDE_WATERSEWER
LongDescription: When activated, the product hidden from the displaying on the main Applications pulldown menu, assuming the product is licensed and loaded.

Name: GPK_MY_CRITERIADIR
LongDescription: Defines criteria files in both an INP file and a CTL file context. Hence, the following syntax could be incorporated to locate criteria files: $(GPK_MY_CRITERIADIR)\curb.x. Relative directories are supported, including those that backtrack: $(GPK_MY_CRITERIADIR)\..\cg\curb.x.

Name: GPK_NOAUTOACTIVATE
LongDescription: Causes GEOPAK to always be inactive when MicroStation is invoked. Define this variable to be anything to enable this operation. To utilize GEOPAK, select GEOPAK > Activate.

Name: GPK_PRJXS_CRITERIADIR
LongDescription: Denotes the default directory where standard criteria files reside. When pressing the Add push button inside the Criteria File group box on the Project Manager > Proposed Cross Sections > Shape Cluster dialog, the directory identified by this configuration variable would appear at the top of the Criteria dialog and the list of criteria files would be located in this directory. Not setting this configuration variable would result in Project Manager looking for criteria files in the working directory. Cross section processing would not be affected by this configuration variable and would continue to operate by looking for criteria files in the same directory as the cross section DGN file.

Name: GPK_PROFILE_COMPUTATION
LongDescription: Set to AASHTO2001 to use this standard or anything else to use 1991 or 1994.

Name: GPK_PROFILE_CURVATURE_TABLE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of K value tables file. When the variables are not utilized, GEOPAK utilizes files located in the GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_PROJECTWISE_CREATION_EXCLUDED_EXTENSIONS
LongDescription: Defines extensions to be excluded from ProjectWise (* = exclude all) GPK_PROJECTWISE_CREATION_EXCLUDED_EXTENSIONS = log,txt,inp

Name: GPK_PROJECTWISE_CREATION_INCLUDED_EXTENSIONS
LongDescription: Defines extensions to be included from ProjectWise (*= include all) GPK_PROJECTWISE_CREATION_INCLUDED_EXTENSIONS = tin,gdf,dlb,gtp

Name: GPK_PROJECTWISE_MESSAGECENTER
LongDescription: Provides messages in the message field for GEOPAK working in a ProjectWise environment. 0 = messages off (default) 1 = messages on

Name: GPK_PROJECTWISE_MESSAGEPOPUP
LongDescription: Provides messages in a dialog box for GEOPAK working in a ProjectWise environment.

Name: GPK_PROJMGR_PROJECTDIR
LongDescription: Denotes the default directory where Project Manager project data (PRJ files) reside. When invoking GEOPAK Project Manager for the first time, this directory appears at the top of the Project Manager dialog. Not setting this configuration variable would cause Project Manager to point to the working directory.

Name: GPK_QUANTITYMANAGER_CFGFILE
LongDescription: Defines a specific Quantity Manager configuration file (.cfg), and ignores the local default version. Utilize when the Quantity Manager works from a file that is not local, for example a file that is located on a central server. The location of this file must be listed using a mapped network drive, as the configuration file does not support conventional file path format.

Name: GPK_RD_NO_DISPLAY_FEATURES
LongDescription: When this is set to 1, it will turn off drawing of roadway designer plan view features. This will enhance the speed of processing within Roadway Designer on larger projects.

Name: GPK_RD_TEMPLATE_LIBRARY
LongDescription: This variable sets the default template library to be used in Corridor Modeling.

Name: GPK_RSCDIR
LongDescription: Defines the location of the GEOPAK resource files.

Name: GPK_SHEET_TYPE_OPTIONS
LongDescription: Determines the options displayed in the plan and cross section Sheet Type. Values are: Plan; Plan and Profile; Profile; Ditch Profiles; Dual Plan; Dual Profile; Maintenance Of Traffic; Cross Sections; Side Road Cross Sections; Ditch Cross Sections

Name: GPK_SHEET_TYPE_OPTIONS_LOCK
LongDescription: When set to 1, the Sheet_Type_Options shown in the sheet applications are locked so the user cannot create a Custom defined sheet type.

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_IGNORE_MISSING_REFS
LongDescription: The ability to ignore missing references files when creating sheets.

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_PLAN_MOTIF_FILE_DIR
LongDescription: Sets the Motif File for the corresponding Plan Port Information dialog. In addition. When not defined, the current working directory is utilized.

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_PROFILE_MOTIF_FILE_DIR
LongDescription: Sets the Motif File for the corresponding Profile Port Information dialog. In addition. When not defined, the current working directory is utilized.

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_PLAN_MOTIF_FILE_DIR
LongDescription: Defines the location of the plan motif seed file directory

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_PLAN_MOTIF_FILE_NAME
LongDescription: References the motif seed file name for plan view

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_PROFILE_MOTIF_FILE_DIR
LongDescription: Defines the location of the profile motif seed file directory

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_PROFILE_MOTIF_FILE_NAME
LongDescription: References the motif seed file name for profile view

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_TABULAR_DATA_MOTIF_FILE_DIR
LongDescription: Defines the location of the tabular data motif seed file directory

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_TABULAR_DATA_MOTIF_FILE_NAME
LongDescription: References the motif seed file name for tabular data view

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_CELL_LIBRARY_DIR
LongDescription: Contains the path in which to search for sheet cell libraries (which are named in the currently attached sheet library) if the entry does not contain a path. If this variable is not defined, cell libraries for sheets are first searched for in the current directory, then in the GEOPAK bin folder.

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_LIBRARY_DIR
LongDescription: This is the path to be used for determining the path of the sheet library as set out in the _DIR Variables section above. Its corresponding dialog items are the Sheet > Library > Attach file selector dialog in the sheet clip application. In the sheet library application, it influences the file selector dialogs for Library > New, Library > Save As, Library > Open if those paths are not already set.

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_LIBRARY_NAME
LongDescription: Path and name for the sheet library. If GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_LIBRARY_NAME is not set, the application opens with default.psl located in the GEOPAK bin folder.

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_OUTPUT_DIR
LongDescription: This is the directory with which to initialize the Output Directory in the Clip Sheets dialog. If the variable is not defined, the current working directory is utilized.

Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_TABULAR_DATA_MOTIF_FILE_DIR
LongDescription: Sets the Motif File for the corresponding Tabular Port Information dialog. In addition. When not defined, the current working directory is utilized.

Name: GPK_SUPER_AUTOSHAPEINPUTDIR
LongDescription: Directory to write autoshape input files and log files. Not setting this configuration variable would cause the tool to initially look in the user's current directory.

Name: GPK_SUPER_EDIR
LongDescription: Directory to search for e-computation csv files. Not setting this configuration variable would cause the tool to initially look in ..\GEOPAK\bin\ bin directory.

Name: GPK_SUPER_EDITOR
LongDescription: Application to use in editing .csv files from the Preference Dialog. There is no default if the variable is not defined. Include the entire path and executable file name.

Name: GPK_SUPER_LENGTHDIR
LongDescription: Directory to search for length-computation csv files. Not setting this configuration variable would cause the tool to initially look in ..\GEOPAK\bin\ bin directory.

Name: GPK_SUPER_PREFDIR
LongDescription: Directory to search for Preferences Files GEOPAK bin directory Not setting this configuration variable would cause the tool to initially look in ..\GEOPAK\bin\ bin directory.

Name: GPK_SURVEY_DISABLEGEODOUTPUT
LongDescription: If this variable is enabled it disables the output screen when processing large data files in order to decrease the delay in processing.

Name: GPK_SURVEY_EXTERNALOBSCONVERTEREXE
LongDescription: This variable allows the user to specify an external OBS converter.

Name: GPK_SURVEY_EXTERNALOBSPARAMS
LongDescription: Parameters to send to the converter exe. %o = Full path to obs file (path only) %g = Full file path and extension of obs to be created or appended to %m = Base name of obs file no extension %p = Full path to raw file (path only) %f = Full file path and extension of raw %n = Base name of raw file no extension %w = 0 for Overwrite, 1 for Append

Name: GPK_SURVEY_LEICADBXDIR
LongDescription: Defines the full path to the Leica Job Directory when using Leica DBX.

Name: GPK_SURVEY_SCANGPKFORORPHANRUNS
LongDescription: Set to 1 on data set open or new if the gpk has any datasets names in it that is not part of current project. It will create a dataset record for the dataset. If set to 0, it will not look for them.

Name: GPK_SURVEY_SEED_DGNFILE
LongDescription: This variable, when set to a full path and seed design file, displays a new test field and icon in the ASCII import dialog to specify an existing or new file name to draw graphics to.

Name: GPK_SURVEY_SEED_SDPFILE
LongDescription: Sets the default settings initially for survey on startup and should include full path, file name and extension. GPK_SURVEY_SEED_SDPFILE = d:/temp/$(units)/def.sdp

Name: GPK_SURVMNGR_SMDFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the default SMD file as well as the default directory for SMD files. When initially invoking the Survey Manager, this SMD file appears in the Path dialog. Moreover, when selecting File > Open, the directory tree is set where this SMD file resides, even if another SMD file from another directory is the current SMD. Not setting this configuration variable would cause Survey Manager to initially look for ...\GEOPAK\bin\default.smd. Subsequent searches would start in the same directory as the current SMD file.

Name: GPK_TABLES_RTRFILE
LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of the default tables file. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses tables.rtr located in the GEOPAK \bin directory.

Name: GPK_TXDOT_SUPER_PARABOLIC_TRANSITION
LongDescription: If set to 1, this variable enables the Texas DOT super elevation non-linear curve option. This option is used to center the parabolic curve length on the transition.

Name: GPK_TYPICAL
LongDescription: Denotes the default directory where typicals files reside. When not set, GEOPAK looks in ..\GEOPAK\samples\road\typical directory.

Name: GPK_TYPICAL_CRITERIA_OUTPUT_DIR
LongDescription: Denotes the directory destination for generated typical section criteria files and any INCLUDE and GET commands utilized within the criteria control file.

Name: GPK_TYPICAL_EDITOR
LongDescription: Setting this variable invokes a different text editor. By default, GEOPAK opens WordPad to view typical description files. If the typical documentation files were created with a different editing or word processing software, it is prudent to review the files utilizing the same software. Include the entire path and executable file name.

Name: GPK_TYPICAL_HELPFILE_EXTENSION
LongDescription: Specifies the default extension of the Typical Section Generator help files. If this is not set then the default extension is .wri.

Name: GPK_TYPICAL_SUPPRESS_CRITERIA_FILE_OVERWRITE_PROMPT
LongDescription: If this variable is enabled then the Typical Section Generator prompt of whether or not to overwrite criteria files is suppressed. GPK_TYPICAL_SUPPRESS_CRITERIA_FILE_OVERWRITE_PROMPT = 1

Name: GPK_TYPICAL_SUPPRESS_SHAPELESS_MODE_VALIDATION_PROMPT
LongDescription: If this variable is enabled then the shapeless mode warning from Typical Section Generator is suppressed. GPK_TYPICAL_SUPPRESS_SHAPELESS_MODE_VALIDATION_PROMPT = 1

Name: GPK_XS_LABEL_DEFAULT_SYMBOLOGY
LongDescription: Points to a setting file used to set the default values for the XS VBA Labeler included in Corridor Modeler. This is an ASCII text file that maybe edited to match local standards.

Name: GPK_XS_LABELER
LongDescription: Denotes the location of the Cross Section Labeler VBA that is called from the Corridor Modeling dialog. If not set the program uses the one delivered with GEOPAK.

Name: GPK_XS_SHEET_LIBRARY_DIR
LongDescription: This is the path used for determining the sheet library. Its corresponding dialog items are the Sheet > Library > Attach file selector dialog in the sheet clip application. In the sheet library application, it influences the file selector dialogs for Library > New, Library > Save As, Library > Open if those paths are not already set. If the user specifies GPK_XS_SHEET_LIBRARY_NAME and that file has no path in it, the applications search for _NAME in the directory _DIR. If it does not find it, it looks next in the current directory then in the ..\GEOPAK\bin directory.

Name: GPK_XS_SHEET_LIBRARY_NAME
LongDescription: The sheet library name and path. If not set, the application opens with default.xssl (located in .GEOPAK\bin).

Name: GPK_XS_SHEET_MODEL_PREFIX
LongDescription: Specifies a prefix to be used when the option is selected to place xs sheets in individual models.

Name: GPKDRG_HYD_METHOD
LongDescription: 0 (Mannings) 1 (Hazen-Williams) 2 (Colebrook White)

Name: GPKDRG_SMOOTH_HGL
LongDescription: If set to 1 is used for smoothing HGL.

Name: GPKHYD_DEFAULT_PROFPREFSEWER
LongDescription: Used to set a file path to the PPF preferences for drawing sewer profiles.

Name: GPKHYD_DEFAULT_PROFPREFSTORM
LongDescription: Used to set a file path to the PPF preferences for drawing drainage profiles.

Name: GPKHYD_DEFAULT_PROFPREFWATER
LongDescription: Used to set a file path to the PPF preferences for drawing water profiles.

Name: GPKLABEL_NODUE_BEARINGS
LongDescription: When set to 1, labels at due North (South, East or West), for example the label would read “Due North” instead of “N 0 00’ 00” E”

Name: OPENGL_WHITE_BACKGROUND
LongDescription: A Windows System Environment Variable can be created so that the backgrounds for the Modeler commands display white instead of black. Define a user variable with a name of OPENQV_WHITE_BACKGROUND and a value of 1 when running MicroStation V8i (SELECTseries 2). Define a user variable with a name of OPENGL_WHITE_BACKGROUND and a value of 1 when running AutoCAD.

Name: OPENQV_WHITE_BACKGROUND
LongDescription: A Windows System Environment Variable can be created so that the backgrounds for the Modeler commands display white instead of black. Define a user variable with a name of OPENQV_WHITE_BACKGROUND and a value of 1 when running MicroStation V8i (SELECTseries 2). Define a user variable with a name of OPENGL_WHITE_BACKGROUND and a value of 1 when running AutoCAD.

Name: MS_COLORBOOK_LIBRARIES
LongDescription: contains the list of DGN files that are used as a source for color books.

Name: MS_DEFCTBL
LongDescription: Default color table if the design file has none.  (MS_DEFCTBL)

Name: MS_LMENCTBL
LongDescription: Default menu colors (dialogs  dialog borders  etc.) for the left screen.  File specification pointing to a color table (.tbl) file (MS_LMENCTBL)

Name: MS_RMENCTBL
LongDescription: Default menu colors (dialogs  dialog borders  etc.) for the right screen.  File specification pointing to a color table (.tbl) file (MS_RMENCTBL)

Name: MS_SYSTEM_COLORBOOKS
LongDescription: sets the directory name containing the system color books delivered with MicroStation.

Name: MS_CMDTABLE_LOAD
LongDescription: List of MDL Applications that will have their key-in tables auto-loaded. (MS_CMDTABLE_LOAD)

Name: COMPONENT_EXPLORER_SETTINGS_HIDE_SCHEMAS
ShortDescription: Component Explorer Query Dialog Schema Filtering
LongDescription: By default  the Query dialog shows classes from all loaded schemas/libraries in the class combo box.  To hide some of the schemas/libraries  you can add them to the following setting concatenated by semi-colons. Ex. Jclass;ams

Name: COMPONENT_EXPLORER_SETTINGS_SHOW_ALL
LongDescription: If no view settings are applied  the default is to show just MEMBERS objects including MEMBERS objects from all reference models.  0 = Don't apply  1 = Apply view setting

Name: COMPONENT_EXPLORER_SETTINGS_SHOW_RELATION_REFERENCES
LongDescription: If no view settings are applied  the default is to show just MEMBERS objects including MEMBERS objects from all reference models.  0 = Don't apply  1 = Apply view setting

Name: MS_REMAP_CSVFILE

Name: BB_ACCELERATE_DYNAMICS
LongDescription:
Acceleration in Dynamics determines whether Part attributes (e.g. rendering, unification and resymbolization) are included in view navigation and dynamics. For larger and more complex models, user may want to accelerate their dynamics by moving to Low or High
None (Default) - Part attributes are displayed during all view navigation and dynamics.
Low -  To accelerate display performance, Part attributes are not displayed during all view navigation and dynamics in the context of Dynamic views

LongDescription: The value is the percentage scale factor for stacked fractions. (70 is normal for DWG files  and is the default if this configuration variable is not defined.)

LongDescription: Stores a thumbnail image in each DGN file that can be seen in the MicroStation file open dialogs  as well as Windows Explorer. Can be used to control the behavior of thumbnail generation.
